issues.problem: “低数据环境下的深度学习 I”准确，但“data-poor regimes”的技术语气略被弱化；“低数据状态/数据稀缺场景”会更贴近正文里关于 sample sparsity 的论述。
issues.suggestion: 可考虑改为“开发者日记：数据稀缺场景下的深度学习 I”，但当前不影响发布。

issues.location: 段落：When I fired GPT-4 for Claude 3 Opus
issues.problem: “因为我懒得把故事推进拆成那种语言学工程”略显生硬，虽然保留了原文玩笑式的口吻，但“linguistics that way”的胡闹动词感还可以更自然。
issues.suggestion: 可改为“因为我懒得按那套语言学方式去工程化故事推进”。

reviews.notes: 译文整体自然，有 Ernie 技术随笔里常见的口语、吐槽和代码切换节奏；它没有机械照搬英文句序，许多长句都重新拆分或顺成了中文表达。MDX、iframe、caption、blockquote-like attribution 与 frontmatter 均未发现读者可见的破损问题。

issues.problem: “说话人分离” is understandable but slightly imprecise for “speaker diarisation”; it can read like audio source separation rather than identifying who spoke when.
issues.suggestion: Consider “说话人分段/标注” or “说话人日志化” depending on house terminology.

issues.problem: “Kahneman-Tversky Optimization” changes the source’s British spelling “Optimisation” inside a coined English technical phrase.
issues.suggestion: Preserve as “Kahneman-Tversky Optimisation” unless the site standardizes all such English terms to US spelling.

reviews.notes: The translation passes: it is natural Mandarin with Ernie’s informal technical-personal voice intact, preserves deliberate code-switching and product/model names, translates captions/alt text, and does not read like a sentence-by-sentence calque. MDX/frontmatter appear structurally sound; the ISO date serialization and translationStatus metadata are not quality issues.
